notes.help_text:
📝 *NOTES COMMANDS*

*Add note:*
{{prefix}}addnote <text>
{{prefix}}newnote <text>
{{prefix}}makenote <text>

*Get one particular note:*
{{prefix}}getnote <number>
{{prefix}}listnote <number>

*Get all your notes:*
{{prefix}}getnotes
{{prefix}}getallnotes
{{prefix}}listnotes

*Update note:*
{{prefix}}updatenote <number> <new text>

*Delete one particular note:*
{{prefix}}delnote <number>
{{prefix}}deletenote <number>
{{prefix}}removenote <number>

*Delete all your notes:*
{{prefix}}delallnotes
{{prefix}}removeallnotes
{{prefix}}deleteallnotes

_Notes na personal thing, dem dey save am well well for database._

badwords.menu:
📋 *Bad Words Management*

*How to use:*
• *.badwords add <word>* - Add bad word
• *.badwords add <word1> <word2>* - Add plenty words
• *.badwords remove <word>* - Remove word
• *.badwords list* - Show all bad words
• *.badwords clear* - Remove all bad words
• *.badwords default* - Load default bad words ({{defaultCount}})
